<!-- Table and tab styling shared by the report notebooks, matching the Master Summary's tables. -->

<style>
  /* Compact tab buttons (many per-patient / per-sample tabs). */
  .panel-tabset .nav-link {
    font-size: 0.9rem !important;
    padding: 0.4rem 0.7rem !important;
  }
  .panel-tabset .nav-link.active { font-weight: 600; }
  /* Tables styled like the Master Summary's reactable tables. */
  .cell-output-display table {
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    border-collapse: collapse;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
  }
  .cell-output-display table thead th {
    background: #f7f7f8;
    font-weight: 600;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #dee2e6;
  }
  .cell-output-display table td,
  .cell-output-display table th { padding: 0.35rem 0.6rem; }
  .cell-output-display table tbody tr:nth-child(even) { background: #fafafa; }
  /* Figures wider than the page (rt_show_wide): kept at full size in a box that scrolls sideways. */
  .fig-scroll {
    overflow-x: auto;
    max-width: 100%;
    border: 1px solid #eee;
    border-radius: 4px;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
  }
  /* Figures outside a tabset (rt_show_box): framed like a tab panel, scrolling sideways when wide. */
  .fig-box {
    border: 1px solid #dee2e6;
    border-radius: 4px;
    padding: 1rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    overflow-x: auto;
  }
</style>
